1. Heard Sri Sandeep Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for applicants and Sri Sanjeev Kumar Singh, Advocate holding brief of Sri Rajeev Kumar Sharma, learned counsel for Opposite Party No. 2.
2.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed to quash the charge sheet dated 20.05.2018 as well as cognizance order dated 27.07.2018 in Case No. 151 of 2018 (State vs. Mustakeem alias Mukeem and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 0059 of 2018, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Maudaha, District Hamirpur.

entities.text: Case No. 151 of 2018 (State vs. Mustakeem alias Mukeem and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. The application is pending for last four years.

This Court vide order dated 14.01.2020 considering submission of learned counsel for applicants that they are ready to settle the issue, referred the case to Mediation Center and an interim order was granted.
However, report of Mediation Center indicates that applicants have neither deposited money nor appeared before Mediation Center on a single date.
4. Aforesaid fact was taken note by this Court in the order dated 22.11.2023 when interim order was vacated.
It is also not on record whether applicants have surrendered before Trial Court concerned or not.
5. Since applicants have not followed the direction passed by this Court and have not appeared before Mediation Center, therefore, their conduct is not bona fide.
As such there is no circumstance exist to invoke inherent jurisdiction.

Even otherwise,
statement of victim recorded during investigation was consistent against applicants that they have committed above referred offence.
6. Application is accordingly rejected with cost of Rs. 1000/- each to be deposited by applicants before High Court Legal Services Committee.
7. Trial Court concerned is directed to take coercive measures, if applicants have not already surrendered.
8. Registrar (Compliance) to take steps.?

3. Learned counsel for applicants refers documents annexed along with this application that requisite amount of Rs. 15,000/- was deposited by way of a bankers cheque and a receipt thereof was also provided by Mediation Center of this Court, therefore, he prays that a fact mentioned in above referred order that applicants have not deposited the amount be expunged as well as cost imposed be made easy.

Order on Application 1.

Sri Sandeep Kumar Shrivastava, learned counsel for applicants refers statements of witnesses recorded during investigation as well as judgment passed by Supreme Court in Kahkashan Kausar @
Sonam and others vs. State of Bihar and others, (2022) 6 SCC 599 that there are general and omnibus allegations and prayer for quashing of charge sheet be considered.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. In present case, initially FIR was lodged against 5 persons, however, after investigation, charge sheet was filed against present applicants i.e. husband and his father and mother.
3. I have carefully perused the statements of witnesses recorded during investigation.

4. Not much reference was made in regard to two named accused in the FIR as well as independent witnesses have also denied their involvement, therefore, concerned I.O. has rightly not filed any charge sheet against them and filed charge sheet only against present applicants.
5. Victim i.e. wife of applicant-1 has specifically made allegations against her husband that not only he demanded dowry but also threw her outside his house.
Even independent witnesses have stated about said facts.
Therefore, there are substantial evidence against applicant-1 before this Court.
6. I have also considered the statements so far as allegations against applicants ?
2 and 3 are concerned i.e. father in law and mother in law of victim.

Victim has stated that she has suffered with cruelty not only by her husband but she was subject to cruelty by her father in law and mother in law also that they have also demanded dowry specifically Rs. 1,00,000/- for purchase of a car.
With the mediation of elders, victim remained with her husband and in laws, however, still they harassed her.
7. She has also stated that she has a threat from applicants as well as that she has also suffered mental cruelty also.
Therefore, Court is of considered opinion that there are allegations against applicants ? 2 and 3 also.

It is not a case of omnibus and general allegations and, therefore,
Kahkashan Kausar (supra) is not applicable in present set of facts.

8. Though not much argument has been placed so far as allegations of offence of Section 323, 504,
506 IPC is concerned, still Court is of considered view that on basis of evidence collected during investigation, since there is no evidence of any hurt, criminal intimidation and intentionally causing insult with intent to provoke breach of peace, therefore, no offence under Sections 323, 504, 506 IPC is made out against applicants.

9. However, there are substantial material for filing charge sheet against applicants under Sections 498-A IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, therefore, this application is allowed in part with an observation that Mustkeem @ Mukeem And 2 Others vs State Of U.P.
